order: ORD-0263 第五态候选 · 交付增量 v2（真因：发布器按文件名遮拦，且 REFUSED 返回 rc=0）

was.my_first_diagnosis: I assumed the same silent batch drop I had hit before and retried the same PUT three times
was.actual_cause: REFUSED (fail-closed, nothing uploaded): FORBIDDEN_NAME_FRAGMENT(_live in s5fix_read_live.json) -- the publisher exits 0 on a refusal, so a script that checks only the return code delivers one file short and reads back 404

totals.this_files_own_readback: recorded by the run's own output and by the bus post below (a file cannot contain its own hash)
totals.note: s5fix_read_live.json was never uploaded, so it is not a missing file at the repo path -- it never existed there; the renamed artifact is the one that counts

for_harness: the guard matches on the FILE NAME; any future artifact whose name contains a protected fragment will be refused with exit 0. Worth a non-zero exit on refusal, and worth printing the refusal reason in the batch log.
addendum_v1_stays: ord0263_s5fix_index_addendum.json keeps its 21/23 reading; this file supersedes its conclusion without altering it
